runtime.checkpointLattice: scripts/phase57_exit_checkpoints_v1.py::checkpoint_grid(day, entry_minute); regular minute m bar closes at m+1
runtime.closedPrefix: closed_prefix filters bar-end and knownAt <= now; rejects future bars
runtime.currentPriceAuthority: position_features(...).currentReturnPct only if freshClosedPrice=true; stale lastObservedClose is never current
runtime.returnSemantics: gross 100*(freshClosedClose/effectiveEntryPrice-1); no R34 fee in state decisions
runtime.milestoneCertification: fresh scheduled closed checkpoint close >= milestone; highest certified never decreases; multiple steps may be skipped in one close; no intrabar High
runtime.preProfit: NONE delegates to R50_A_LIFECYCLE; no new early SELL
runtime.freshBelow: strict currentReturnPct < current floor; equal intact
runtime.confirmation: two adjacent scheduled checkpoints on checkpoint_grid both fresh and below applicable floor; missing resets streak and cannot bridge adjacency; lunch adjacency uses grid
runtime.missing: no certification, no breach, no recovery, no SELL; clear ALERT continuity; Control authority survives
runtime.promotionDuringAlert: promote milestone and floor then reset breach streak to 0 and ACTIVE
runtime.earliestAuthority: Control intent before candidate stops candidate; candidate before Control emits SELL_INTENT; same checkpoint records BOTH_TRIGGER_SAME_CHECKPOINT; no holding beyond Control terminal
runtime.fill: canonical next eligible scheduled fill; missing fill=null; confirmed fill only for cash release; intent never canceled
runtime.safety: all order, paper, live, transmission, promotion and production flags false
runtime.potentialAuthority: none; no HOLD veto, SELL, Guard override, sizing or ranking

readiness.R1: fresh plus missing equals every scheduled checkpoint, 100%
readiness.R4: every Primary111 deterministic terminal class: candidate first/control first/both/control terminal without candidate/unresolved canonical Control or fill reason
readiness.R6: no provider or restricted partition access
readiness.noBehaviorFastClose: primary candidate-first SELL_INTENT=0 and all-entry candidate-first SELL_INTENT=0 => NO_BEHAVIORAL_DELTA, no candidate Replay

economicGates.focusedTests: all 30 enumerated handoff checks pass before economic Replay
economicGates.layerA: archived R50 funded IM79/R1_32, same Entry and quantity, exact R34 corrected net; compare Control, R54, CCMG
economicGates.winner: for each IM>=5,IM>=10,R1>=5,R1>=10: exact candidate mean R34 net >= Control AND aggregate JPY PnL >= Control; one negative exact delta fails, no bootstrap forgiveness
economicGates.loser: IM <1,1-3,3-5 aggregate CCMG PnL>=Control; R1 each if known paired N>=5; N<5 inconclusive; combined <5 known paired aggregate >=Control; any applicable negative delta fails
economicGates.allEntry: IM819/R1_795 standalone 100 shares, five fixed buckets; both arms same-direction >=5 or >=10 mean net regression => ALL_ENTRY_WINNER_CONTRADICTION blocks selection; one-arm warning
economicGates.giveback: certified close HWM over fresh checkpoints while owned up to each policy intent, decision and confirmed fill gross giveback; mechanism only, no true peak capture claim
economicGates.retention: by certified 1/2/3/5/10 realized gross at exit versus floor; report slippage/gap, diagnostic only
economicGates.capitalEligibility: Layer A Integrity, Winner, Loser PASS and no all-entry blocking contradiction
economicGates.capital: 24/24 certified EOD and measurable Final Equity required to claim PASS; >JPY1m and >= same-arm Control; min cash>=0; MaxDD and cash lock reported
economicGates.stress: 0.20 percentage-point fee stress with certified 24/24 EOD, Final Equity>JPY1m and >=stress Control
economicGates.measurementNull: MEASUREMENT_BLOCKED and productionReady=false; do not equate closed PnL to Final Equity
economicGates.selection: one candidate; after all required Gates PASS selectedDevelopment=CCMG_GUARD_V1, productionReady=false; otherwise NO_SELECTION
economicGates.reproducibility: dry trace byte-identical; Layer A same events/fills/PnL; integrated two passes ledger/decisions/fills/daily/equity/selection/manifest identical
economicGates.northStar: JPY1m to ~JPY2m in 24 sessions, ~2.93% geometric daily; diagnostic only if certified Final Equity

potentialForensics.recoveryPassB: exact source commit/raw hashes/transform/row and feature order/expected output hash known; regenerated bytes hash exactly equals expected
